The YAML '|' change (bd0f31ce1 -> 9aead23f0) is a text rewrite, not a port of YamlParser.getBlockStyleString: keep_block_line_breaks (crates/rustuml-parser/src/parse/json_diagram.rs) appends '+' to every line whose trimmed end is ': |', including lines inside a block scalar body. Java's getBlockStyleString (133-149) copies such a body line with cleanBlockStyle (151-154: trim only), so the value text is 'example: |'. The tip draws 'example: |+' (pre-registered: y8_block_inner_pipe tip text 'example: |+

The same change misses Java's own block headers: YamlLine.build (52-97) trims the value and removes a YAML comment before comparing with '|', so 'note:   |' and 'note: | # tail' are blocks in Java; the rewrite needs the literal ': |' ending (K6A y8_block_spaced_pipe, y8_block_comment_pipe). cleanBlockStyle trims every body line, so deeper indentation is dropped in Java and kept by serde_yml (y8_block_relative_indent: tip 'Moss\n  Fern\nReed').
